news.headline: US 10Y yield jumps to 5.10%; Wall Street slips
news.what_happened: US 10Y yield rose about 10bps to 5.10%. S&P 500 -0.35%, Nasdaq -0.39%.
news.why_it_matters: Elevated US yields keep FII flows into EMs under pressure; Indian markets already cited US bond yields for capping gains on Nov 12.

news.headline: Gold +0.64% to ~$3,910/oz
news.what_happened: Gold and silver both rose (silver +0.69%) as yields and risk-off mood lifted safe havens.
news.why_it_matters: Higher gold prices raise collateral value for gold-loan NBFCs.

news.headline: Nifty closes at 25,299 (+0.18%), third straight gain
news.what_happened: Realty +4%, PSU banks and Bank Nifty led; autos lagged. Midcap +0.85%, smallcap +1.12%. Profit booking in heavyweights capped gains.
news.why_it_matters: Domestic momentum is positive but global cues (yields, Hang Seng -0.54%) are mixed; Nikkei +1.44%.

picks.logic: Rising gold lifts collateral value of the gold-loan book, supporting AUM and sentiment. Modest target set as only a mild catalyst.

risks: US 10Y at 5.1% - further yield spike could trigger FII selling
